content.title: Implementation Plan
content.content:
**3. Implementation Methodology**

SnapLogic follows a proven 4-phase deployment model for enterprise on-premises implementations:

- **Phase 1: Foundation and setup (est 2 weeks)**
- **Phase 2: Informatica pilot and team enablement (est 4–6 weeks)**
- **Phase 3: Production migration and go-live (est 8–12 weeks)**
- **Phase 4: Hypercare and knowledge transfer (est 2–4 weeks)**

**3.1 Proposed Timeline**

[TABLE:simple:Project Timeline]
| Phase | Duration | Activities | Deliverables |
|-------|----------|------------|-------------|
| **1. Foundation** | Week 1–2 | Ground Plex deployment on OpenShift; Connectivity validation; RBAC/SSO setup | Operational platform, connectivity sign-off |
| **2. Pilot & Enablement** | Week 3–8 | Select 3–5 representative Informatica mappings; Automated + manual conversion; Technical training workshops; SnapGPT enablement | 5 converted pipelines validated; Team trained and productive |
| **3. Production Migration** | Week 9–20 | Remaining mapping conversion; UAT and performance testing; Cutover planning; Production deployment | All pipelines migrated and production-ready |
| **4. Hypercare** | Week 21–24 | On-site/remote PS support; Incident response and optimization; Knowledge transfer and handover | Stable operations, team self-sufficient |
[/TABLE]

**3.2 Proposed Enabling Steps**

- Lead Solution Engineer — support for technical setup during Phase 1
- Technical training workshops — hands-on SnapLogic Developer training (3 days)
- SnapGPT enablement — Citizen Integrator training for business analysts (1 day)
- PS engagement — dedicated consultant for Phases 1–3; optional for Phase 4
- Quarterly business reviews — ongoing post-implementation

**4.0 Pricing & Commercial**

- Professional Services — PS pricing and fixed-deliverable options
- Engagement duration: 20–24 weeks estimated including hypercare phase
- Perpetual or subscription licensing options available
